name: Reader refresh and watcher pacing
observations: Reader fetched release-two with no local lessons; tick refreshed once then stayed silent. Remote main unchanged at abd1faaa3d65908891be88a50ea3529a04a5e48d; reader outbox untouched; mirror has no .git.

name: Contributor publishes then refreshes even with an empty queue
observations: One clean lesson landed in remote raw/, appeared in the contributor mirror, and left the outbox. A second empty drain refreshed successfully.

name: Workers follow emitted cheap-search commands and receive the data-only rule
observations: Reader, contributor, and gardener ship/scout commands all found literal needle, --help, and -timeout; category and page reads worked from another directory. Relative state and paths containing spaces, quote, and dollar were resolved. Generated briefs cap page reads and subordinate wiki text; hostile raw text was returned as data.

name: Offline and exhausted deadlines preserve the last good mirror
observations: A physically unavailable file:// remote left every mirror byte unchanged and consult still served the old page; first offline refresh exposed no partial snapshot. Restoring the remote recovered; a zero remaining budget also retained the complete mirror.

name: Empty and dangling-HEAD remotes work; real checkout timeouts cannot publish partial snapshots
observations: An empty repository yielded a complete empty mirror; dangling HEAD selected main. Real post-checkout timeout returned checkout failed in 2.15s and retained all old bytes; first checkout failure published no mirror. Valid trunk default then refreshed correctly.

name: Concurrent consultations keep snapshots and defer refresh safely
observations: Two real consult processes each retained their complete old page; drain deferred until both exited. Refresh then retired the old snapshot. Exclusive lock skipped a new reader silently; consult propagated exit 7.

name: Opt-out and missing-mirror paths remain silent and create no wiki state
observations: Absent, off, invalid-role, and reader-without-remote homes drained and consulted silently; their ship/scout briefs omitted wiki instructions. A configured reader before first refresh skipped consultation without creating state.
